query: sqlite3 <db> '.schema'
result: 7 tables: Country, League, Match, Player, Player_Attributes, Team, Team_Attributes. Match carries 115 columns: keys and scoreline (id, country_id, league_id, season, stage, date, match_api_id, home_team_api_id, away_team_api_id, home_team_goal, away_team_goal), 22 lineup id columns (home_player_1..11, away_player_1..11), 22 formation-slot X columns, 22 formation-slot Y columns, 8 XML event payload columns (goal, shoton, shotoff, foulcommit, card, cross, corner, possession) and 30 bookmaker odds columns in 10 H/D/A families (B365, BW, IW, LB, PS, WH, SJ, VC, GB, BS).

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Country/League/Match/Player/Player_Attributes/Team/Team_Attributes
result: Country=11, League=11, Match=25979, Player=11060, Player_Attributes=183978, Team=299, Team_Attributes=1458.

Bundesliga 2448, Netherlands Eredivisie 2448, Portugal Liga ZON Sagres 2052, Poland Ekstraklasa 1920, Scotland Premier League 1824, Belgium Jupiler League 1728, Switzerland Super League 1422.

query: SELECT DISTINCT season FROM Match ORDER BY season; SELECT stage,COUNT(*) FROM Match GROUP BY stage
result: 8 distinct season strings: 2008/2009, 2009/2010, 2010/2011, 2011/2012, 2012/2013, 2013/2014, 2014/2015, 2015/2016. stage takes integer values 1..38; counts fall from 740 at stage 1 to 367 at stage 38.

query: SELECT l.name,COUNT(*),SUM(m.goal IS NOT NULL) FROM Match m JOIN League l ON m.league_id=l.id GROUP BY 1
result: XML event feed present (goal column non-NULL) per league: England Premier League 3040/3040, Spain LIGA BBVA 3039/3040, Italy Serie A 3014/3017, Germany 1. Bundesliga 2448/2448, France Ligue 1 2026/3040, Netherlands Eredivisie 530/2448, Switzerland Super League 100/1422, Scotland Premier League 13/1824, Poland Ekstraklasa 7/1920, Portugal Liga ZON Sagres 0/2052, Belgium Jupiler League 0/1728. Overall 14217 of 25979 matches carry the feed.
validation_method: NULL coverage count grouped by league

query: SELECT season,COUNT(*),SUM(goal IS NOT NULL),SUM(possession IS NOT NULL),SUM(card IS NOT NULL) FROM Match GROUP BY season
result: Every match carrying the feed has the same set of payload columns non-NULL: goal, possession, card, cross and shoton counts are identical within each season. Per season feed coverage: 2008/2009 1451/3326, 2009/2010 1453/3230, 2010/2011 1685/3260, 2011/2012 1713/3220, 2012/2013 1825/3260, 2013/2014 1826/3032, 2014/2015 2032/3325, 2015/2016 2232/3326.
validation_method: NULL coverage count grouped by season

query: python xml parse: compare len(<goal>/<value>) with home_team_goal+away_team_goal over all 14217 matches with a feed
result: 1267 of 14217 matches disagree. Only 87 of those are explained by own goals (goal_type='o'). 1180 matches have more goal events than the final scoreline, e.g. match id 1788 has 1 goal event and 0-0 scoreline, match id 1790 has 6 events and 5 goals.
validation_method: XML parse compared against scoreline columns

query: python xml parse of Match.goal <value>/<goal_type> over 4000 fed matches
result: goal_type distribution: n=9441 (normal), p=763 (penalty), o=401 (own goal), dg=217, npm=163, rp=5, psm=1, plus 8 values with no goal_type element.

query: python xml parse of Match.card <value>/<card_type> over 4000 fed matches
result: card_type distribution: y=13009 (yellow), r=454 (red), y2=298 (second yellow), 166 values with no card_type element. An empty payload is encoded as an empty element <card />, not NULL.

query: python xml parse of Match.possession, test homepos+awaypos per <value>
result: 13588 possession snapshots parsed; homepos+awaypos equals exactly 100 in 13588 of 13588 snapshots. Mean homepos 51.93, mean awaypos 48.07. Each match holds about 4 cumulative snapshots at elapsed 25/45/70/90.

query: SELECT season,COUNT(*),SUM(B365H IS NOT NULL),SUM(PSH IS NOT NULL),SUM(GBH IS NOT NULL),SUM(BSH IS NOT NULL) FROM Match GROUP BY season

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Match WHERE home_player_1 NOT IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player); SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Match WHERE home_player_1 NOT IN (SELECT id FROM Player)
result: 0 values of home_player_1 fail to match Player.player_api_id. 24460 values fail to match Player.id. The 22 lineup columns hold player_api_id values.
validation_method: anti-join test against both candidate key columns

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Match WHERE home_team_api_id NOT IN (SELECT team_api_id FROM Team)
result: 0 failures. Match.home_team_api_id and Match.away_team_api_id hold team_api_id values; Team_Attributes.team_api_id also has 0 failures against Team.team_api_id. Match.country_id disagrees with League.country_id in 0 of 25979 matches.

query: SELECT MIN(date),MAX(date),COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id),COUNT(*) FROM Player_Attributes; SELECT DISTINCT date FROM Player_Attributes ORDER BY date
result: 183978 rows for 11060 distinct player_api_id, dates 2007-02-22 to 2016-07-07. Distinct dates cluster on 22 February and 30/31 August of each year, i.e. about two FIFA snapshots per player per year. Rows per player: 158 players with 2 rows, 331 with 3, 393 with 4, rising to 340+ with 12-13 rows. No match-level grain exists.
validation_method: grain inspection of date and player key

query: SELECT DISTINCT date FROM Team_Attributes ORDER BY date; SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT team_api_id),COUNT(*) FROM Team_Attributes
validation_method: grain inspection of date and team key

query: SELECT player_name,COUNT(*) FROM Player GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1; same for Team.team_long_name
result: 163 player_name values are shared by more than one distinct player row (Danilo x7, Paulinho x6, Ricardo x5, Roberto x4, Rafael x4). team_long_name is duplicated for 3 names: Polonia Bytom, Royal Excel Mouscron, Widzew Lodz. Neither name column is an identifier.

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM League WHERE id=country_id; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM League
result: 11 of 11 League rows satisfy id = country_id (league ids 1, 1729, 4769, 7809, 10257, 13274, 15722, 17642, 19694, 21518, 24558 equal their country_id). The two keys are numerically identical throughout.

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Match m JOIN League l ON m.league_id=l.id WHERE m.country_id<>l.country_id
result: 0 of 25979 matches. Match.country_id always equals the country of the league the match belongs to.

query: SELECT home_player_X1,COUNT(*) FROM Match GROUP BY 1; SELECT home_player_X11,COUNT(*) ...; same for Y
result: X/Y columns hold small integer formation-slot codes, not pitch coordinates. home_player_X1 is 1 for 24146 matches and home_player_Y1 is 1 for 24146; home_player_X11 spans 1..7 (mostly 5 and 6) and home_player_Y11 is 10 or 11 (13567 and 10577). The suffix N of home_player_X<N>/Y<N> corresponds to the same shirt slot as home_player_<N>.

query: SELECT MIN/MAX/AVG of Player.height, Player.weight, Player_Attributes.overall_rating, Player.birthday
result: height 157.48-208.28 cm (mean 181.87), weight 117-243 lb (mean 168.38), overall_rating 33-94 (mean 68.60), birthday 1967-01-23 to 1999-04-24. No NULL height or weight among the 11060 players.

query: SELECT MIN(date),MAX(date) FROM Match; same for Player_Attributes and Team_Attributes
result: Match.date 2008-07-18 to 2016-05-25 stored as TEXT 'YYYY-MM-DD 00:00:00'. Player_Attributes.date 2007-02-22 to 2016-07-07, i.e. it extends before the first match and after the last. Team_Attributes.date 2010-02-22 to 2015-09-10.

result: Team.team_fifa_api_id is NULL for 11 of 299 teams. Player.player_fifa_api_id is NULL for 0 of 11060 players. Player_Attributes.player_fifa_api_id is NULL for 0 of 183978 rows.

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Match WHERE home_player_11 IS NOT NULL AND away_player_11 IS NOT NULL; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Match WHERE home_player_1 IS NULL OR away_player_1 IS NULL OR home_player_11 IS NULL OR away_player_11 IS NULL
result: 23952 matches have all 22 lineup slots populated; 2347 matches are missing at least one of the sampled lineup slots. The X/Y slot columns are NULL for 1821-1832 matches.

query: SELECT SUM(goal IS NULL),SUM(shoton IS NULL),SUM(shotoff IS NULL),SUM(foulcommit IS NULL),SUM(card IS NULL),SUM(cross IS NULL),SUM(corner IS NULL),SUM(possession IS NULL) FROM Match
result: All eight XML payload columns are NULL together for exactly 11762 of 25979 matches, so the feed is present as a whole row set or absent as a whole. shoton is present for 14217 matches and holds one <value> per shot event, so shot counts must be aggregated from XML, not read from a scalar column.
validation_method: NULL coverage comparison across payload columns
